name: wp-template-macro-value-rejected
description: [PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] Values matching /^\{\{.+\}\}$/ (unsubstituted ad-platform macros like {{campaign.name}}) are rejected entirely. The TS engine sanitizes but keeps them literally.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (ruling #15): values matching the unsubstituted-template-macro pattern '{{...}}' are rejected outright; remaining UTMs still create the touch. Original note: plugin macro guard vs engine literal passthrough.
